region.name: Celestide Isles
region.description: A floating archipelago where wind currents carry celestial energy. The islands are connected by natural bridges and floating platforms. The region is known for its unique Pokémon that have adapted to the high-altitude, wind-swept environment.

locations.name: Skysong Harbor
locations.description: A bustling port town built on the largest floating island. The harbor is filled with wind-powered ships and gliders. Professor Liora's research lab overlooks the harbor, studying the unique Pokémon of the region.

locations.name: Route 2 - Southern Approach
locations.description: A scenic route connecting Skysong Harbor to the Skyfall Expanse. Wind currents make travel easier, and wild Pokémon are more active during certain times of day.

locations.name: Breeze Path
locations.description: A gentle floating route with grassy platforms and air currents. Wild Pidgey flock overhead. Celestide Mareep sightings are reported near the windier platforms.

locations.name: Gym 1 — Zephyra's Wind Gym
locations.description: An open-air arena perched on a wind-swept platform. Strong gusts sweep across the battle floor. Gym Leader Zephyra teaches control through balance, not force.

locations.name: Skyfall Expanse
locations.description: A vast open area between islands where trainers can practice battling. The wind here is strong, making it a popular spot for Flying-type Pokémon.

factions.name: Wind Wardens
factions.philosophy: Protect the natural wind currents and celestial energy balance

recurring_npcs.name: Zephyra
recurring_npcs.notes: Gym 1 Flying specialist. Philosophy: control through balance, not force.

world_facts.title: Celestial Alignment
world_facts.description: Every 100 years, the celestial bodies align perfectly over the Celestide Isles, causing a surge in Pokémon activity and rare encounters.

world_facts.title: Wind Currents
world_facts.description: The wind currents in the region are currently favorable, making travel between islands easier and faster.

scene.description: Episode 2 complete — Alex has crossed Breeze Path. Wind banners from Skysong Harbor are a distant memory; ahead, Gym 1 rises on a wind-swept platform. Gym Leader Zephyra stands at the arena center: 'The Gale Badge isn't won by force — it's earned by balance. Show me you can read the currents, not fight them.'
